stories.headline: Ukrainian strikes kill three in Russia’s Belgorod region
stories.description: Russian strikes also cut power to Ukrainian cities as Moscow claims 700 Ukrainian drones downed across multiple regions.

stories.headline: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
stories.description: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.

stories.headline: Iranian leaders welcome US midterms, but Trump may still attack
stories.description: Tehran views midterm results as a rejection of Trump’s ‘war on Iran’, signalling US frustration with foreign policy.
